$comment: NOT RENDERED. The pipeline renderer reads only the template settings file (its top-level keys are a closed set). parked_jobs lists every GitHub Actions job that has no running Buildkite step yet, with the reason and the blocker, so nothing is dropped. To port one, write its step script (and verbatim gates) once the blocker lands, add the step to extra_steps in the pipeline settings, and move its row in .buildkite/README.md. This is a public repository: a step that needs a secret also needs a secrets entry for a public pipeline, which does not exist today.

parked_jobs.reason: `npm ci` installs @wave-av/spoke-chassis and @wave-av/container-pool from GitHub Packages, which the Buildkite agents cannot read from (HTTP 403). The step would fail every build at install.
parked_jobs.blocked_on: WAVE's self-hosted npm registry (in progress) (with @wave-av/container-pool in its package list), plus a registry read credential for this public pipeline

parked_jobs.reason: advisory A/B benchmark. It checks out its harness from a private repository with CONFORMANCE_REPO_PAT on pull_request builds only, and posts a sticky PR comment with a GitHub write token. In this public repository a step holds a secret only when it needs it on main, and this one never runs on main. Its two cold source builds of ffmpeg also exceed the 60-minute step cap (GitHub allows 120). The tools are not the blocker: the CI image has Docker with buildx, ffmpeg 6.1.1 and Go 1.27.1.
parked_jobs.blocked_on: a PR-build credential decision for a public pipeline (or a public harness), a GitHub write path for the comment (the GitHub-event bridge, in progress), and a persistent build cache that fits the step cap

parked_jobs.reason: GitHub-only plumbing: it reports whether CONFORMANCE_REPO_PAT is provisioned so `bench` can no-op. It has no meaning without `bench`.

only writes the main-branch recipe's layers into the GitHub Actions cache (type=gha) so PR bench runs start warm. Buildkite CI machines are single-use and have no shared layer cache, so the build would warm nothing; a cold build of the recipe (AVM + ffmpeg from source) also exceeds the 60-minute step cap.
parked_jobs.blocked_on: a persistent build cache for CI jobs, and `bench` being ported

parked_jobs.reason: production deploy on push to main (wrangler deploy with Cloudflare credentials). Deploy and publish jobs are out of scope for this port.
parked_jobs.blocked_on: an explicit decision to move the deploy to Buildkite
